title: DEMONSTRATION ONLY - social media and political participation
demonstration_notice: Example data only. No papers, findings, claims, or gaps are verified.

population_or_units: young adults where a university subsample is identifiable
comparison: different forms and intensities of use
context: higher education and relevant political contexts
scope.timeframe: To be set by the demonstration user

subquestions: What forms of social media use are associated with political participation among university students?
Which forms of political participation appear most strongly related to social media use?
Through what mechanisms might social media influence political participation?
Under what social, political, or platform conditions does this relationship vary?
What methodological limitations prevent existing studies from establishing causal effects?

include: Addresses the demonstration population, exposure, outcome, theory, or method role defined by the protocol
exclude: Uses overlapping population or technology terms without relevance to an approved political-participation question
